statement:
The recorded access right of 'open' is not safe or correct for this case because the participants consented to access on request only, which requires restricted access to protect participant-level data.

Because the access record is incorrectly set to 'open' rather than 'restricted' (access on request), publishing the deposit under its current record would violate participant consent and breach data privacy. Therefore, deposit 542201 cannot be published until the access record is corrected to restricted access.
